notes.title: Update/fix is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

New update that should fix a couple of very elusive bugs like pets not showing up is here! Thanks to our users who brought it to our attention! Also for being so patient! 

Happy fishing! Yaaaaarrrrrr!

notes.title: Fix/Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey, thanks for playing the game! 
This is a quick note to let you know that we're dealing with the file corruption a rare couple of users are experiencing. It's being fixed and undergoing testing now. We'll release a new update as soon as possible, so stay tuned! :)

notes.title: An update is on its way! Yarrr!
notes.content:
Hello! We're uploading a patch ASAP to fix some minor interface bugs. We'll also be patching shortly after to fix French translation issues, so thank you for your patience!

We care a lot about user experience, so please drop us a line in the forums if there are any issues. 

You can also contact us at support@kestrelgames.com.

Thanks for your support!
